facts.text: Jordan Rivera lives in Austin, Texas
Jordan is 34 years old and was born in Miami, Florida
Jordan works as a Senior Software Engineer at a company called Meridian AI
Jordan has a dog named Mochi, a rescue greyhound adopted one year ago
Jordan's best friend is Maya Chen, a data scientist who lives in Denver and works at Palantir
Jordan met Maya Chen at PyCon 2021 in Salt Lake City
Jordan has a brother named Sam Rivera who is a product manager at Google and lives in Seattle
Jordan's parents are named Elena and Carlos, and they live in Miami, Florida
Jordan enjoys rock climbing at the Austin Bouldering Project

Jordan's favorite author is Ted Chiang, and a favorite story is Story of Your Life
Jordan owns a Specialized Diverge gravel bike

Quick intro since this is a fresh chat — I'm Jordan Rivera, a senior software engineer living in Austin, Texas.
Nice to meet you, Jordan. What's on your mind?
I just got back from a great hike at Barton Creek near my house here in Austin.
Barton Creek is beautiful! How was the trail?
Gorgeous. I grew up in Miami but I've been in Austin for about three years now—so much better for outdoor stuff.
Have you done much climbing here too?
Yeah, I go to the Austin Bouldering Project pretty regularly. Mochi, my greyhound, waits in the car—I rescued her about a year ago.
